command: pre-registration: probe OF (D1 object-frame transfer H1-H4, D2 attention anchor gate, D3 vision what/where + anchor)

metrics.H1: D1 l90c part (obj:named spliced mode): T_obj >= 0.5, T_obj - T_world >= 0.3, T_obj > T_ctrl, Holm p
metrics.H2: D1 l90c instr mode: as H1
metrics.d1_statistic: leave-scene-out 3-parameter approach model per object type, P2 corr2 pooled per type, mean over types (>= 5 frames, >= 2 scenes); each frame at its own best level of {0.1, 0.3, 0.55} as P2; own samples, part variants, alt instructions, null, object_trans and P2-centre descriptive
metrics.d2_gate: word->agentview attention, mean heads x role word rows x layers {0,1,2}, argmax in the oracle region; hit(wrong) >= hit(success) - 0.10 and >= 2 x chance; l90c zs episode types (episode means, R2a ci_rate), libero own-sample plurality proxy (observation unit); object role primary, goal role reported likewise
metrics.d3_gates: SigLIP region-pooled leave-scene-out nearest-prototype accuracy >= 0.8 and >= 3 x chance; stable if |acc far - acc near| <= 0.10 (median centroid shift); dissociation = both; vision anchor = argmax per-token cosine to the named type prototype, gate as D2
metrics.disclosure: seen before this row: P2/P3, R2a, R3b, R3c, L0/L0b/L1 published results (docs/ATLAS.md); the index / poses / select logs (task lists, candidate and kept frame counts, object types per scene; no model output); a 2-frame GPU smoke per model (results/of/scratch: runtime, conditions, image-vs-sim-render alignment correlations; no endpoint, transfer, attention or feature statistic computed).  The index was rerun once before the poses were used, adding a filter that the instruction's FIRST step is put / pick up / stack (two-step tasks starting with turn on / open approach another body before the named object).  D3 was added by the user (via the coordinator) before this row was written and is pre-registered in it.  P2's transfer definition was read from experiments/pp2_dev.py; the D1 statistic generalises it (docs/PLAN_OF.md section 0).  Hypothesis family: Holm over H1-H4 (D1 only); D2 / D3 are estimate gates.
metrics.family: Holm over H1-H4 at 0.05; p = max of the two one-sided task-cluster bootstrap p (obj <= world, obj <= ctrl)
metrics.route1: alive if H1 or H3; instruction-level only if only H2/H4; dead otherwise
metrics.written_before: any D1 / D2 / D3 statistic, any D1 frame or dev observation run beyond the 2-frame smoke
